queries: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_stats ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;

WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_stats ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: All observatory stations, including those with no telescopes, count toward the average telescope count per station.

alternatives.interpretation: Include only stations that have at least one telescope.
